import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String args[]) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        int ans = 0;
        
        for (String group : splitIntoGroups(s)) {
            if (group.length() % 2 == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    private static List<String> splitIntoGroups(String s) {
        List<String> groups = new ArrayList<>();
        int n = s.length();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int j = i;
            while (j < n && s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(i)) {
                j++;
            }
            groups.add(s.substring(i, j));
            i = j;
        }
        return groups;
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String args[]) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        
        AtomicInteger ans = new AtomicInteger(0);
        s.chars()
         .mapToObj(c -> (char) c)
         .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(
             c -> s.indexOf(c),
             LinkedHashMap::new,
             Collectors.counting()
         ));
         
        // Manual grouping approach
        int i = 0, n = s.length();
        while (i < n) {
            int j = i;
            while (j < n && s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(i)) {
                j++;
            }
            if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
                ans.incrementAndGet();
            }
            i = j;
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans.get());
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String args[]) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        
        int ans = 0;
        int n = s.length();
        
        IntStream.rangeClosed(0, n).reduce(0, (i, next) -> {
            if (i >= n) return i;
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            int j = i;
            while (j < n && s.charAt(j) == c) {
                j++;
            }
            if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            return j;
        });
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
